evidence.title: AXON Protocol — The Identity & Wallet Layer for AI Agents

name: AXON Protocol
summary: Landing page for AXON Protocol: on-chain identity, smart wallets and trustless escrow for AI agents on Base.
description: Marketing site for AXON Protocol, an on-chain infrastructure layer for AI agents built on Base (Ethereum L2). It covers three primitives — Agent Identity as ERC-721 NFTs with metadata, capability tags and reputation; ERC-4337 smart wallets with daily limits, operator permissions and emergency freeze; and trustless escrow with mutual cancellation and dispute resolution — plus protocol stats, a three-step how-it-works, JavaScript code examples, a four-phase roadmap and an airdrop signup.
contains: core primitives: Agent Identity (ERC-721), Smart Wallets (ERC-4337), Trustless Escrow
protocol stats: contracts deployed live, Base Sepolia testnet, 0.3% protocol fee, built on Base
how it works in three steps: register, fund, transact
JavaScript code examples for registerAgent and createEscrow calls
roadmap: Phase 1 foundation (live) to Phase 4 scale (2027)
